s: Din habdala bitpilla ubo z' seipim: keshettiqqenu anshe keneset haggedola leyisrael nussach habberakot utepillot veqiddushim vehabdalot — tiqqenu habdala bitpilla bilbadda velo al hakkos, lepi shekkeshealu min haggola hayu dechuqim baaniyyut velo haya sippeq beyad kullam liqnot yayin lehabdala. Vetiqqenuha bebirkat "chonen haddaat", mippene shehahabdala sheadam yodea lehabdil ben qodesh lechol chokma hi lo, lepikak qebauha bebirkat chokma. Veod, mippene sheasur litboa tzerakayv bemotzae shabbat qodem habdala kemo sheasur beshabbat atzmo, lepikak qebauha qodem sheelat tzerakayv shebbibrakot emtzaiyyot:

Veachar kak kesheheeshiru yisrael qebauha chakamim al hakkos, ukeshechazeru veheenu chazeru chakamim uqebauha bitpilla, ukede shello yehe hahabdala mittaltelet tadir al yede osher veoni mittepilla lekos umikkos litpilla — hitqinu chakamim shelleolam tzarik kol adam hammabdil bitpilla lehabdil gam al hakkos im yukal limtzo. Vetzarik lechazzer acharayv kederek shemmechazzerim al shear kol mitzvot shehen chobat haggup, ella im ken i epshar lo limtzo — azay yotze yede chobato behabdala shebbitpilla. Verashshay leekol im eno metzappeh sheyyihyeh lo kos lemachar beyom rishon, ap shemmetzappeh sheyyihyeh lo achar kak — en tzarik lehitannot ad sheyyabdil al hakkos, ella rashshay leekol miyyad, shekkebar yatza yede chobato behabdala shebbitpilla. (Veim metzappeh sheyyihyeh lo lemachar beyom — yitbaer besimman rtz"v). Veen tzarik lomar shehammabdil al hakkos qodem shehitpallel arbit shetztzarik lehazkir hahabdala bitpilla, shehare iqqar taqqanat hahabdala (haya bitpilla) shettiqqenu anshe keneset haggedola keshealu min haggola hayeta lehazkirah bitpilla. Veken mi sheshshakach o neenas velo hitpallel arbit bemotzae shabbat umitpallel shacharit shettayim — tzarik lehazkir habdala bitpilla sheniyya shehi letashlumin, ap al pi shekkebar hibdil al hakkos ballayla, lepi shehahabdala shebbitpilla hi iqqar hattaqqana:

Im taa velo hizkir habdala bechonen haddaat — mashlim tepillato, velo yachazor bishbil hahabdala, hoil vetzarik adayin leomrah al hakkos veyihyeh yotze yede chobato. Raq sheyyizzaher millaasot shum melaka qodem sheyyabdil al hakkos, o yomar achar tepilla "hammabdil ben qodesh lechol" belo beraka veyaaseh melaka, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman rtz"t. Veim shakach (veasa melaka beissur, o) taam meuma qodem sheyyabdil al hakkos — tzarik lachazor ulehitpallel ulehabdil bitpilla vegam al hakkos, sheeno yotze bahabdala sheal hakkos bilbaddah, hoil veenah kehogen, shettaam (o asa melaka) qodem lah:

Im taa velo hizkir habdala bitpilla veen lo kos ballayla vesabur sheap lemachar lo yihyeh lo — tzarik lachazor ulehitpallel miyyad ulehazkir habdala bitpilla, ap al pi shemmetzappeh sheyyihyeh lo achar kak, mikkol maqom min hassetam en dato lehitannot kol kak, veim yitom meuma eno — yotze bahabdala sheal hakkos bilbaddah, kemo shennitbaer (bisip g'):

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennizkar achar siyyum tepillato, veaz tzarik lachazor lerosh hattepilla im kebar aqar raglayv, o shekkebar siyyem hattachanunim sheragil lomar leachar tepillato, kemo shennitbaer besimman qy"z, o apillu im nizkar beemtza tepillato ella shekkebar siyyem birkat "shomea tepilla", veaz tzarik lachazor lerosh birkat "atta chonen". Abal im nizkar qodem shessiyyem birkat "shomea tepilla" — yomrenna be"shomea tepilla", kemo mi sheshshakach sheela bebirkat hashshanim sheomerah be"shomea tepilla". Veap sheyyesh omerim sheenah doma lishela shehi tepilla ubaqqasha, veyesh lah inyan bebirkat "shomea tepilla", shehi gam ken tepilla ubaqqasha, mah sheen ken habdala en lah inyan kelal le"shomea tepilla", vedibrehem iqqar, velaken mi sheyyesh lo kos, o shemmetzappeh sheyyihyeh lo kos lemachar, ap shennizkar qodem "shomea tepilla" — lo yomrenna be"shomea tepilla", mikkol maqom mi sheeno metzappeh kelal lekos lemachar veyitztarek lachazor ulehitpallel — yesh lo lismok al sebara rishona leomrah be"shomea tepilla", velo lachazor lebirkat "atta chonen", shello likkanes lispeq berakot sheenam tzerikim:

Tisha beab shechal lihyot beechad beshabbat, im taa velo hizkir habdala bitpillat arbit — en tzarik lachazor. Veap im nizkar qodem "shomea tepilla" — al yomrenna be"shomea tepilla", hoil veyomrenna adayin al hakkos bemotzae t' beab veyihyeh yotze yede chobato, shehare lo yitom meuma qodem motzae t' beab:

Bekol maqom sheen tzarik lachazor bishbil sheshshakach lehazkir habdala, ap im nizkar miyyad shehizkir hashshem shebbesiyyum birkat "atta chonen", o miyyad shessiyyem beraka zo, ap al pi shello patach adayin bibraka shelleachareha — lo yachazor lerosh birkat "atta chonen"z ap im rotzeh lehachamir al atzmo, sheasur lebarek beraka sheenah tzerika. Veap im rotzeh lomar "atta chonantanu" belo chatima — eno rashshay, mishshum hepseq bitpilla. Veken haddin bekol maqom shennizkar betok hattepilla. Abal im siyyem tepillato verotzeh lachazor ulehitpallel merosh hattepilla betorat nedaba — hareshut beyado, veal derek shennitbaer besimman q"z. Veim nizkar qodem shehizkir hashshem shebbesiyyum birkat "atta chonen" — yatchil miyyad "atta chonantanu", veyigmor mishsham al hasseder: "vechannenu meitteka veku', baruk atta Hashem veku'":
